sara_cs: Quick one-pager for Nova trial kickoff tomorrow — cache / batch / stream + what to validate. Short and shareable.

sara_cs: TL;DR: cache-first for repeated prompts; batch to reduce cost on many small calls; stream for interactive UIs. Rollback if latency doubles.

sara_cs: Pre-launch checks:
- Warm pool >= expected TPS for the first 2h (start at 1.2x if unsure).
- Telemetry owner: platform-observability (validate p95 latency, 5xx, cache-hit-rate).

ben_sre: Recommend trace sampling 10% first 48h, then 1%. Also cap per-tenant cache entries on Dedicated.

elaine_eng: Short curl test to show cache behavior:
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"ping","cache_key":"nova_ping_v1"}' -i
Second request should show header "x-cache: HIT".

sara_cs: Batching knobs (customer-facing): start window 10ms, max 75ms; maxBatch 64 on big GPUs, 32 on small. Probe traffic recommended during business hours.

sara_cs: Streaming tip: flush partial tokens every ~50ms or on sentence boundary. If stream fails, retry once after 200ms then fall back to non-stream endpoint.

sara_cs: Rollback trigger: if p95 >2x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes -> set cache TTL=0 and reduce batch window to 5ms.

doc-bot: Docs repo updated at commit f1a2b3 in /docs/onboarding/one-pagers.

sara_cs: I'll attach this one-pager to the invite and collect the customer's chosen TTLs & batch policy in the follow-up thread. Thanks!
